verdicts.observation: tome-cults/data/zones/town-kroshkkur/npcs.lua:108-109 (unpinned): 'disfigured' means deformed/misshapen (畸形/扭曲), and desc says 'A vaguely humanoid shape'. 不成型 means formless/unshaped, which contradicts the vaguely humanoid form described.

tome-cults/data/general/npcs/blobs.lua:94 (unpinned): 'hemospinner' = hemo(blood)+spinner. 递呈者 borrows the immunology term 'presenting' (as in antigen-presenting cell), which the source does not say, and drops the blood/spinning meaning entirely. Only 'dendritic' (树突) is carried over.

tome-cults/data/talents/demented/oblivion.lua:58 (unpinned): the source info string is one line, but the target inserts a newline plus two literal TAB characters (\n\t\t) before 增加（减少）, so a stray line break and tabs render in the talent tooltip. The trigger 'applied or increased to you' is also shortened to 受到熵能反冲时, which drops the 'increased' (stack/extend) case.

tome-cults/data/lore/fay-willows.lua:528,530 (unpinned): 'Catching my breathe I explained' means recovering breath (缓过气/喘口气) but is rendered 我屏住呼吸 (held my breath), which contradicts the panting scene in line 526. 'the two guards murmer something to each other' means they whispered to each other, but is rendered 互相默默无语 (silent to each other), which is the opposite. Minor: 'I was walked through the process' (she guided me) is rendered as 我开始了激活符文的过程, which loses the guidance.

tome-cults/data/achievements/all.lua:165 (unpinned): the source says the player was saved from death in the Godfeaster by Malyu and managed to escape. The target 被马虑护送离开巨大蠕虫噬神者 drops both 'saved from death' and 'managed to escape', leaving only 'escorted out', so the rescue-from-death condition is lost.

tome-cults/data/lore/fay-willows.lua:717,723 (unpinned): 'Aranion stepped out in full view' (stepped into plain sight) is rendered 全神贯注地走了出来 (walked out fully concentrating), which is a mistranslation. 'I was about to charge towards the rest' (the remaining skeletons) is rendered 冲向其他地方 (toward other places). Minor: line 713 把我们传送帷幕的另一边 is missing 到.
